"extends Node

# =============================================================================
# O RATO DETETIVE 2.0
# Roguelike infinito - Godot 4.x
# Núcleo unificado de gameplay
# =============================================================================

enum WeaponType { DESERT_EAGLE, SHOTGUN, THOMPSON }
enum Rarity { COMMON, RARE, EPIC, LEGENDARY, FUSION }
enum EnemyType { MOUSERTRAP, MAFIA_CAT, MAFIA_BOSS }

const MAX_LEVEL := 50
const INVULNERABILITY_TIME := 1.0
const SUPER_CHEESE_DURATION := 30.0
const SUPER_CHEESE_DROP_CHANCE := 0.01
const SPAWN_INTERVAL := 1.5
const MAX_ENEMIES := 100

# =============================================================================
# 1. CONFIGURAÇÕES GERAIS
# =============================================================================

@export var auto_start := true
@export var auto_spawn := true
@export var starting_weapon := WeaponType.DESERT_EAGLE
@export var arena_size := Vector2(1600, 1000)

var game_running := false
var game_over := false

var player
var enemies: Array = []
var projectiles: Array = []

var spawn_timer := 0.0
var elapsed_time := 0.0
var total_kills := 0
var total_cheese := 0

var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()

# =============================================================================
# 2. CLASSE DO JOGADOR
# =============================================================================

class PlayerClass:
	var position := Vector2.ZERO
	var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
	var base_speed := 220.0

	var max_hearts := 5
	var current_hearts := 5
	var hits_per_heart := 2
	var current_heart_hits := 2

	var is_invulnerable := false
	var invulnerable_timer := 0.0

	var loop_count := 0
	var damage_multiplier := 1.0
	var xp_multiplier := 1.0
	var speed_multiplier := 1.0

	var super_cheese_timer := 0.0
	var is_super_cheese_active := false

	var active_weapon
	var skills: Dictionary = {}

	var money := 0
	var score := 0

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		active_weapon = WeaponClass.new(weapon_type)

	func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
		if is_invulnerable or current_hearts <= 0:
			return

		current_heart_hits -= amount

		if current_heart_hits <= 0:
			current_hearts -= 1
			current_heart_hits = hits_per_heart

			print(\"Coração perdido! Restantes: \", current_hearts)

			if current_hearts <= 0:
				die()
			else:
				trigger_invulnerability(1.0)

	func trigger_invulnerability(duration: float) -> void:
		is_invulnerable = true
		invulnerable_timer = max(invulnerable_timer, duration)

	func update_timers(delta: float) -> void:
		if is_invulnerable:
			invulnerable_timer -= delta

			if invulnerable_timer <= 0:
				is_invulnerable = false
				invulnerable_timer = 0

		if is_super_cheese_active:
			super_cheese_timer -= delta

			if super_cheese_timer <= 0:
				is_super_cheese_active = false
				super_cheese_timer = 0
				print(\"Superqueijo terminou!\")

	func activate_super_cheese() -> void:
		is_super_cheese_active = true
		super_cheese_timer = 30.0
		trigger_invulnerability(30.0)

		print(\"SUPERCHEESE! Dano x10 e invulnerabilidade por 30 segundos!\")

	func get_damage_multiplier() -> float:
		var multiplier := damage_multiplier

		if is_super_cheese_active:
			multiplier *= 10.0

		if skills.has(\"damage\"):
			multiplier *= skills[\"damage\"]

		return multiplier

	func die() -> void:
		current_hearts = 0
		print(\"FIM DE JOGO: O detetive caiu na sarjeta.\")


# =============================================================================
# 3. CLASSE DAS ARMAS
# =============================================================================

class WeaponClass:
	var type: int

	var damage := 0.0
	var fire_rate := 0.0
	var max_ammo := 0
	var current_ammo := 0
	var reload_time := 0.0
	var range_dist := 0.0

	var fire_timer := 0.0
	var reload_timer := 0.0
	var is_reloading := false

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		type = weapon_type

		match type:
			0: # DESERT EAGLE
				damage = 35.0
				fire_rate = 0.6
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 1.2
				range_dist = 800.0

			1: # SHOTGUN
				damage = 50.0
				fire_rate = 1.2
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 2.5
				range_dist = 350.0

			2: # THOMPSON
				damage = 8.0
				fire_rate = 0.15
				max_ammo = 49
				reload_time = 2.0
				range_dist = 500.0

		current_ammo = max_ammo

	func update(delta: float) -> void:
		fire_timer = max(0.0, fire_timer - delta)

		if is_reloading:
			reload_timer -= delta

			if reload_timer <= 0:
				current_ammo = max_ammo
				is_reloading = false
				print(\"Arma recarregada!\")

	func can_shoot() -> bool:
		return not is_reloading and current_ammo > 0 and fire_timer <= 0

	func shoot() -> bool:
		if not can_shoot():
			return false

		current_ammo -= 1
		fire_timer = fire_rate

		if current_ammo <= 0:
			reload()

		return true

	func reload() -> void:
		if is_reloading or current_ammo == max_ammo:
			return

		is_reloading = true
		reload_timer = reload_time

		print(\"Recarregando...\")

# =============================================================================
# 4. CLASSE DOS INIMIGOS
# =============================================================================

class EnemyClass:
	var enemy_type: int

	var position := Vector2.ZERO
	var health := 0.0
	var max_health := 0.0
	var speed := 0.0
	var damage := 0

	var attack_range := 35.0
	var attack_cooldown := 1.0
	var attack_timer := 0.0

	var xp_reward := 0
	var is_dead := false
	var is_boss := false

	func _init(type: int, loop_multiplier: float):
		enemy_type = type

		match type:
			0: # RAT0EIRA
				max_health = 20.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 180.0
				damage = 1
				xp_reward = 15

			1: # GATO MAFIOSO
				max_health = 60.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 120.0
				damage = 2
				xp_reward = 40

			2: # CHEFÃO
				max_health = 1000.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 75.0
				damage = 2
				xp_reward = 500
				attack_range = 65.0
				attack_cooldown = 1.5
				is_boss = true

		health = max_health

	func take_damage(amount: float) -> bool:
		if is_dead:
			return false

		health -= amount

		if health <= 0:
			health = 0
			is_dead = true
			return true

		return false

	func move_towards(target: Vector2, delta: float) -> void:
		var direction := target - position

		if direction.length() > 0:
			position += direction.normalized() * speed * delta

	func update_attack(delta: float) -> bool:
		attack_timer = max(0.0, attack_timer - delta)

		if attack_timer <= 0:
			attack_timer = attack_cooldown
			return true

		return false

# =============================================================================
# 5. SISTEMA DE HABILIDADES
# =============================================================================

var skill_database := {
	\"speed\": {
		\"name\": \"Pés Ligeiros\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.COMMON,
		\"description\": \"Aumenta a velocidade de movimento em 10%.\",
		\"max_level\": 5
	},

	\"damage\": {
		\"name\": \"Munição Especial\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.RARE,
		\"description\": \"Aumenta o dano em 15%.\",
		\"max_level\": 5
	},

	\"reinforced_vest\": {
		\"name\": \"Colete Reforçado\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.RARE,
		\"description\": \"Reduz o dano recebido em 1 ponto.\",
		\"max_level\": 3
	},

	\"rapid_fire\": {
		\"name\": \"Gatilho Rápido\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.EPIC,
		\"description\": \"Aumenta a cadência de tiro em 20%.\",
		\"max_level\": 5
	},

	\"flaming_cigar\": {
		\"name\": \"Charuto Flamejante\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.EPIC,
		\"description\": \"Adiciona dano incendiário aos disparos.\",
		\"max_level\": 1
	},

	\"double_shot\": {
		\"name\": \"Tiros Duplos\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.EPIC,
		\"description\": \"Dispara dois projéteis por ataque.\",
		\"max_level\": 1
	},

	\"detective_eye\": {
		\"name\": \"Olho de Detetive\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.LEGENDARY,
		\"description\": \"Aumenta o alcance das armas em 40%.\",
		\"max_level\": 1
	},

	\"flaming_fusion\": {
		\"name\": \"Chama do Submundo\",
		\"rarity\": Rarity.FUSION,
		\"description\": \"Combina Charuto Flamejante e Tiros Duplos.\",
		\"max_level\": 1
	}
}

var pending_skills: Array = []

func generate_skill_choices(amount: int = 3) -> Array:
	var available: Array = []

	for skill_id in skill_database:
		var skill = skill_database[skill_id]
		var current_level = player.skills.get(skill_id, 0)

		if current_level < skill[\"max_level\"]:
			if skill_id == \"flaming_fusion\":
				continue

			available.append(skill_id)

	var choices: Array = []

	while choices.size() < amount and available.size() > 0:
		var index = rng.randi_range(0, available.size() - 1)
		choices.append(available[index])
		available.remove_at(index)

	return choices

func offer_skill_choices() -> void:
	pending_skills = generate_skill_choices()

	print(\"\nESCOLHA UMA HABILIDADE:\")

	for i in range(pending_skills.size()):
		var skill_id = pending_skills[i]
		var skill = skill_database[skill_id]

		print(
			i + 1, \" - \",
			skill[\"name\"],
			\" | Raridade: \",
			Rarity.keys()[skill[\"rarity\"]],
			\" | \",
			skill[\"description\"]
		)

	if pending_skills.is_empty():
		print(\"Nenhuma habilidade disponível.\")

func select_skill(index: int) -> void:
	if index < 0 or index >= pending_skills.size():
		print(\"Escolha inválida.\")
		return

	var skill_id = pending_skills[index]
	var current_level = player.skills.get(skill_id, 0)

	player.skills[skill_id] = current_level + 1

	match skill_id:
		\"speed\":
			player.speed_multiplier *= 1.10

		\"damage\":
			pass # Aplicado pelo multiplicador de dano.

		\"reinforced_vest\":
			pass # Aplicado no cálculo de dano recebido.

		\"rapid_fire\":
			player.active_weapon.fire_rate *= 0.80

		\"flaming_cigar\":
			pass # Efeito incendiário aplicado no combate.

		\"double_shot\":
			pass # Aplicado no disparo.

		\"detective_eye\":
			player.active_weapon.range_dist *= 1.40

	_check_fusion()

	print(\"Habilidade adquirida: \", skill_database[skill_id][\"name\"])

	pending_skills.clear()

func _check_fusion() -> void:
	if (
		player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) >= 1
		and player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) >= 1
		and player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) == 0
	):
		player.skills[\"flaming_fusion\"] = 1
		player.skills[\"flaming_cigar\"] = 0
		player.skills[\"double_shot\"] = 0

		print(\"FUSÃO DESBLOQUEADA: CHAMA DO SUBMUNDO!\")

# =============================================================================
# 6. EXPERIÊNCIA E PROGRESSÃO
# =============================================================================

var current_level := 1
var current_xp := 0
var xp_to_level_up := 100

func add_xp(amount: int) -> void:
	var gained := int(amount * player.xp_multiplier)

	current_xp += gained
	total_cheese += gained

	print(\"Queijo obtido: \", gained)

	while current_xp >= xp_to_level_up and game_running:
		current_xp -= xp_to_level_up
		level_up()

func level_up() -> void:
	current_level += 1

	xp_to_level_up = int(ceil(xp_to_level_up * 1.3))

	print(\"\n========== LEVEL UP ==========\")
	print(\"Nível atual: \", current_level)

	if current_level % 10 == 0:
		trigger_miniboss_encounter()
	else:
		offer_skill_choices()

	if current_level >= MAX_LEVEL:
		trigger_ground_hole_loop()

# =============================================================================
# 7. MINIBOSSES E CHEFÕES
# =============================================================================

func trigger_miniboss_encounter() -> void:
	print(\"ALERTA! A MÁFIA ESTÁ ENVIANDO UM CHEFÃO!\")

	var boss = EnemyClass.new(
		EnemyType.MAFIA_BOSS,
		get_enemy_multiplier()
	)

	boss.position = player.position + Vector2(300, 0)
	enemies.append(boss)

	print(\"Derrote o chefão para receber uma recompensa lendária!\")

func reward_boss() -> void:
	player.money += 100
	player.score += 1000

	print(\"CHEFÃO DERROTADO!\")
	print(\"Recompensa: $100 e habilidade lendária!\")

	var legendary_skills: Array = []

	for skill_id in skill_database:
		if skill_database[skill_id][\"rarity\"] == Rarity.LEGENDARY:
			if player.skills.get(skill_id, 0) == 0:
				legendary_skills.append(skill_id)

	if legendary_skills.size() > 0:
		var chosen = legendary_skills[
			rng.randi_range(0, legendary_skills.size() - 1)
		]
		player.skills[chosen] = 1
		print(\"Habilidade lendária adquirida: \", skill_database[chosen][\"name\"])

# =============================================================================
# 8. LOOP INFINITO / ASCENSÃO
# =============================================================================

func trigger_ground_hole_loop() -> void:
	print(\"\nPORTAL DO BUEIRO ABERTO!\")

	player.loop_count += 1

	player.damage_multiplier *= 2.0
	player.xp_multiplier *= 2.0

	current_level = 1
	current_xp = 0
	xp_to_level_up = 100

	player.position = Vector2.ZERO

	print(\"BEM-VINDO AO LOOP \", player.loop_count)
	print(\"Dano: x\", player.damage_multiplier)
	print(\"XP: x\", player.xp_multiplier)
	print(\"Vida dos inimigos: x\", get_enemy_multiplier())

func get_enemy_multiplier() -> float:
	return pow(2.0, player.loop_count)

# =============================================================================
# 9. GERAÇÃO DE INIMIGOS
# =============================================================================

func spawn_enemy(type: int = -1) -> void:
	if enemies.size() >= MAX_ENEMIES:
		return

	if type == -1:
		type = (
			EnemyType.MOUSERTRAP
			if rng.randf() < 0.65
			else EnemyType.MAFIA_CAT
		)

	var enemy = EnemyClass.new(type, get_enemy_multiplier())

	var angle = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
	var distance = rng.randf_range(500.0, 700.0)

	enemy.position = player.position + Vector2(
		cos(angle) * distance,
		sin(angle) * distance
	)

	enemies.append(enemy)

# =============================================================================
# 10. SISTEMA DE COMBATE
# =============================================================================

func find_nearest_enemy() -> EnemyClass:
	var nearest = null
	var nearest_distance = INF

	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance < nearest_distance:
			nearest_distance = distance
			nearest = enemy

	return nearest

func perform_attack() -> void:
	var weapon = player.active_weapon

	if not weapon.can_shoot():
		return

	var target = find_nearest_enemy()

	if target == null:
		return

	var distance = player.position.distance_to(target.position)

	if distance > weapon.range_dist:
		return

	if not weapon.shoot():
		return

	var final_damage = weapon.damage * player.get_damage_multiplier()

	var double_shot = player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) > 0
	var flaming = player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) > 0
	var fusion = player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) > 0

	match weapon.type:

		0: # DESERT EAGLE
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

		1: # SHOTGUN
			var direction = (target.position - player.position).normalized()

			for enemy in enemies:
				if enemy.is_dead:
					continue

				var enemy_distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

				if enemy_distance > weapon.range_dist:
					continue

				var enemy_direction = (
					enemy.position - player.position
				).normalized()

				var angle = abs(direction.angle_to(enemy_direction))

				if angle <= deg_to_rad(35):
					var distance_multiplier = clamp(
						1.0 - enemy_distance / (weapon.range_dist * 1.5),
						0.25,
						1.0
					)

					apply_damage_to_enemy(
						enemy,
						final_damage * distance_multiplier
					)

		2: # THOMPSON
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

	if flaming or fusion:
		apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage * 0.20)

func apply_damage_to_enemy(enemy, damage: float) -> void:
	if enemy == null or enemy.is_dead:
		return

	if enemy.take_damage(damage):
		on_enemy_killed(enemy)

func on_enemy_killed(enemy) -> void:
	total_kills += 1
	player.score += 10

	print(\"Inimigo eliminado!\")

	add_xp(enemy.xp_reward)

	if enemy.is_boss:
		reward_boss()
		return

	drop_loot(enemy)

func drop_loot(enemy) -> void:
	match enemy.enemy_type:

		0:
			if rng.randf() < SUPER_CHEESE_DROP_CHANCE:
				player.activate_super_cheese()
			else:
				add_xp(10)

		1:
			player.money += 2
			add_xp(20)

# =============================================================================
# 11. RECEBIMENTO DE DANO
# =============================================================================

func damage_player(amount: int) -> void:
	var reduction = player.skills.get(\"reinforced_vest\", 0)
	var final_damage = max(1, amount - reduction)

	player.take_damage(final_damage)

	if player.current_hearts <= 0:
		end_game()

# =============================================================================
# 12. MOVIMENTAÇÃO
# =============================================================================

func move_player(delta: float) -> void:
	var direction = Input.get_vector(
		\"ui_left\",
		\"ui_right\",
		\"ui_up\",
		\"ui_down\"
	)

	player.velocity = direction * (
		player.base_speed * player.speed_multiplier
	)

	player.position += player.velocity * delta

	player.position.x = clamp(
		player.position.x,
		-arena_size.x / 2,
		arena_size.x / 2
	)

	player.position.y = clamp(
		player.position.y,
		-arena_size.y / 2,
		arena_size.y / 2
	)

# =============================================================================
# 13. ATUALIZAÇÃO DOS INIMIGOS
# =============================================================================

func update_enemies(delta: float) -> void:
	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance > enemy.attack_range:
			enemy.move_towards(player.position, delta)
		else:
			if enemy.update_attack(delta):
				damage_player(enemy.damage)

	enemies = enemies.filter(
		func(enemy):
			return not enemy.is_dead
	)

# =============================================================================
# 14. INICIALIZAÇÃO E CICLO PRINCIPAL
# =============================================================================

func _ready() -> void:
	rng.randomize()

	if auto_start:
		start_game()

func start_game() -> void:
	player = PlayerClass.new(starting_weapon)

	enemies.clear()
	projectiles.clear()

	current_level = 1
	current_xp = 0
	xp_to_level_up = 100

	total_kills = 0
	total_cheese = 0
	elapsed_time = 0.0
	spawn_timer = 0.0

	game_over = false
	game_running = true

	player.position = Vector2.ZERO

	print(\"================================\")
	print(\"O RATO DETETIVE\")
	print(\"JOGO INICIADO!\")
	print(\"Arma inicial: \", WeaponType.keys()[starting_weapon])
	print(\"================================\")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not game_running or game_over:
		return

	elapsed_time += delta

	player.update_timers(delta)
	player.active_weapon.update(delta)

	move_player(delta)

	if auto_spawn:
		spawn_timer += delta

		if spawn_timer >= SPAWN_INTERVAL:
			spawn_timer = 0.0
			spawn_enemy()

	update_enemies(delta)
	perform_attack()

func end_game() -> void:
	if game_over:
		return

	game_over = true
	game_running = false

	print(\"\n========== FIM DE JOGO ==========\")
	print(\"Loops alcançados: \", player.loop_count)
	print(\"Nível: \", current_level)
	print(\"Inimigos eliminados: \", total_kills)
	print(\"Queijo coletado: \", total_cheese)
	print(\"Pontuação: \", player.score)
	print(\"Tempo sobrevivido: \", elapsed_time)

func restart_game() -> void:
	start_game()

# =============================================================================
# 15. CONTROLES DE TESTE
# =============================================================================

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not game_running:
		if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_accept\") and game_over:
			restart_game()
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_cancel\"):
		player.active_weapon.reload()

	if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_accept\"):
		if pending_skills.size() > 0:
			select_skill(0)

# =============================================================================
# FIM DO SCRIPT

class PlayerClass:
	var position := Vector2.ZERO
	var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
	var base_speed := 220.0

	var max_hearts := 5
	var current_hearts := 5
	var hits_per_heart := 2
	var current_heart_hits := 2

	var is_invulnerable := false
	var invulnerable_timer := 0.0

	var loop_count := 0
	var damage_multiplier := 1.0
	var xp_multiplier := 1.0
	var speed_multiplier := 1.0

	var super_cheese_timer := 0.0
	var is_super_cheese_active := false

	var active_weapon
	var skills: Dictionary = {}

	var money := 0
	var score := 0

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		active_weapon = WeaponClass.new(weapon_type)

	func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
		if is_invulnerable or current_hearts <= 0:
			return

		current_heart_hits -= amount

		if current_heart_hits <= 0:
			current_hearts -= 1
			current_heart_hits = hits_per_heart

			print(\"Coração perdido! Restantes: \", current_hearts)

			if current_hearts <= 0:
				die()
			else:
				trigger_invulnerability(1.0)

	func trigger_invulnerability(duration: float) -> void:
		is_invulnerable = true
		invulnerable_timer = max(invulnerable_timer, duration)

	func update_timers(delta: float) -> void:
		if is_invulnerable:
			invulnerable_timer -= delta

			if invulnerable_timer <= 0:
				is_invulnerable = false
				invulnerable_timer = 0

		if is_super_cheese_active:
			super_cheese_timer -= delta

			if super_cheese_timer <= 0:
				is_super_cheese_active = false
				super_cheese_timer = 0
				print(\"Superqueijo terminou!\")

	func activate_super_cheese() -> void:
		is_super_cheese_active = true
		super_cheese_timer = 30.0
		trigger_invulnerability(30.0)

		print(\"SUPERCHEESE! Dano x10 e invulnerabilidade por 30 segundos!\")

	func get_damage_multiplier() -> float:
		var multiplier := damage_multiplier

		if is_super_cheese_active:
			multiplier *= 10.0

		if skills.has(\"damage\"):
			multiplier *= skills[\"damage\"]

		return multiplier

	func die() -> void:
		current_hearts = 0
		print(\"FIM DE JOGO: O detetive caiu na sarjeta.\")

class WeaponClass:
	var type: int

	var damage := 0.0
	var fire_rate := 0.0
	var max_ammo := 0
	var current_ammo := 0
	var reload_time := 0.0
	var range_dist := 0.0

	var fire_timer := 0.0
	var reload_timer := 0.0
	var is_reloading := false

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		type = weapon_type

		match type:
			0: # DESERT EAGLE
				damage = 35.0
				fire_rate = 0.6
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 1.2
				range_dist = 800.0

			1: # SHOTGUN
				damage = 50.0
				fire_rate = 1.2
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 2.5
				range_dist = 350.0

			2: # THOMPSON
				damage = 8.0
				fire_rate = 0.15
				max_ammo = 49
				reload_time = 2.0
				range_dist = 500.0

		current_ammo = max_ammo

	func update(delta: float) -> void:
		fire_timer = max(0.0, fire_timer - delta)

		if is_reloading:
			reload_timer -= delta

			if reload_timer <= 0:
				current_ammo = max_ammo
				is_reloading = false
				print(\"Arma recarregada!\")

	func can_shoot() -> bool:
		return not is_reloading and current_ammo > 0 and fire_timer <= 0

	func shoot() -> bool:
		if not can_shoot():
			return false

		current_ammo -= 1
		fire_timer = fire_rate

		if current_ammo <= 0:
			reload()

		return true

	func reload() -> void:
		if is_reloading or current_ammo == max_ammo:
			return

		is_reloading = true
		reload_timer = reload_time

		print(\"Recarregando...\")

class EnemyClass:
	var enemy_type: int

	var position := Vector2.ZERO
	var health := 0.0
	var max_health := 0.0
	var speed := 0.0
	var damage := 0

	var attack_range := 35.0
	var attack_cooldown := 1.0
	var attack_timer := 0.0

	var xp_reward := 0
	var is_dead := false
	var is_boss := false

	func _init(type: int, loop_multiplier: float):
		enemy_type = type

		match type:
			0: # RAT0EIRA
				max_health = 20.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 180.0
				damage = 1
				xp_reward = 15

			1: # GATO MAFIOSO
				max_health = 60.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 120.0
				damage = 2
				xp_reward = 40

			2: # CHEFÃO
				max_health = 1000.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 75.0
				damage = 2
				xp_reward = 500
				attack_range = 65.0
				attack_cooldown = 1.5
				is_boss = true

		health = max_health

	func take_damage(amount: float) -> bool:
		if is_dead:
			return false

		health -= amount

		if health <= 0:
			health = 0
			is_dead = true
			return true

		return false

	func move_towards(target: Vector2, delta: float) -> void:
		var direction := target - position

		if direction.length() > 0:
			position += direction.normalized() * speed * delta

	func update_attack(delta: float) -> bool:
		attack_timer = max(0.0, attack_timer - delta)

		if attack_timer <= 0:
			attack_timer = attack_cooldown
			return true

		return false

var pending_skills: Array = []

func generate_skill_choices(amount: int = 3) -> Array:
	var available: Array = []

	for skill_id in skill_database:
		var skill = skill_database[skill_id]
		var current_level = player.skills.get(skill_id, 0)

		if current_level < skill[\"max_level\"]:
			if skill_id == \"flaming_fusion\":
				continue

			available.append(skill_id)

	var choices: Array = []

	while choices.size() < amount and available.size() > 0:
		var index = rng.randi_range(0, available.size() - 1)
		choices.append(available[index])
		available.remove_at(index)

	return choices

func offer_skill_choices() -> void:
	pending_skills = generate_skill_choices()

	print(\"\nESCOLHA UMA HABILIDADE:\")

	for i in range(pending_skills.size()):
		var skill_id = pending_skills[i]
		var skill = skill_database[skill_id]

		print(
			i + 1, \" - \",
			skill[\"name\"],
			\" | Raridade: \",
			Rarity.keys()[skill[\"rarity\"]],
			\" | \",
			skill[\"description\"]
		)

	if pending_skills.is_empty():
		print(\"Nenhuma habilidade disponível.\")

func select_skill(index: int) -> void:
	if index < 0 or index >= pending_skills.size():
		print(\"Escolha inválida.\")
		return

	var skill_id = pending_skills[index]
	var current_level = player.skills.get(skill_id, 0)

	player.skills[skill_id] = current_level + 1

	match skill_id:
		\"speed\":
			player.speed_multiplier *= 1.10

		\"damage\":
			pass # Aplicado pelo multiplicador de dano.

		\"reinforced_vest\":
			pass # Aplicado no cálculo de dano recebido.

		\"rapid_fire\":
			player.active_weapon.fire_rate *= 0.80

		\"flaming_cigar\":
			pass # Efeito incendiário aplicado no combate.

		\"double_shot\":
			pass # Aplicado no disparo.

		\"detective_eye\":
			player.active_weapon.range_dist *= 1.40

	_check_fusion()

	print(\"Habilidade adquirida: \", skill_database[skill_id][\"name\"])

	pending_skills.clear()

func _check_fusion() -> void:
	if (
		player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) >= 1
		and player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) >= 1
		and player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) == 0
	):
		player.skills[\"flaming_fusion\"] = 1
		player.skills[\"flaming_cigar\"] = 0
		player.skills[\"double_shot\"] = 0

		print(\"FUSÃO DESBLOQUEADA: CHAMA DO SUBMUNDO!\")

var current_level := 1
var current_xp := 0
var xp_to_level_up := 100

func add_xp(amount: int) -> void:
	var gained := int(amount * player.xp_multiplier)

	current_xp += gained
	total_cheese += gained

	print(\"Queijo obtido: \", gained)

	while current_xp >= xp_to_level_up and game_running:
		current_xp -= xp_to_level_up
		level_up()

func level_up() -> void:
	current_level += 1

	xp_to_level_up = int(ceil(xp_to_level_up * 1.3))

	print(\"\n========== LEVEL UP ==========\")
	print(\"Nível atual: \", current_level)

	if current_level % 10 == 0:
		trigger_miniboss_encounter()
	else:
		offer_skill_choices()

	if current_level >= MAX_LEVEL:
		trigger_ground_hole_loop()

# =============================================================================
# 7. MINIBOSSES E CHEFÕES
# =============================================================================

func trigger_miniboss_encounter() -> void:
	print(\"ALERTA! A MÁFIA ESTÁ ENVIANDO UM CHEFÃO!\")

	var boss = EnemyClass.new(
		EnemyType.MAFIA_BOSS,
		get_enemy_multiplier()
	)

	boss.position = player.position + Vector2(300, 0)
	enemies.append(boss)

	print(\"Derrote o chefão para receber uma recompensa lendária!\")

func reward_boss() -> void:
	player.money += 100
	player.score += 1000

	print(\"CHEFÃO DERROTADO!\")
	print(\"Recompensa: $100 e habilidade lendária!\")

	var legendary_skills: Array = []

	for skill_id in skill_database:
		if skill_database[skill_id][\"rarity\"] == Rarity.LEGENDARY:
			if player.skills.get(skill_id, 0) == 0:
				legendary_skills.append(skill_id)

	if legendary_skills.size() > 0:
		var chosen = legendary_skills[
			rng.randi_range(0, legendary_skills.size() - 1)
		]
		player.skills[chosen] = 1
		print(\"Habilidade lendária adquirida: \", skill_database[chosen][\"name\"])

# =============================================================================
# 8. LOOP INFINITO / ASCENSÃO
# =============================================================================

func trigger_ground_hole_loop() -> void:
	print(\"\nPORTAL DO BUEIRO ABERTO!\")

	player.loop_count += 1

	player.damage_multiplier *= 2.0
	player.xp_multiplier *= 2.0

	current_level = 1
	current_xp = 0
	xp_to_level_up = 100

	player.position = Vector2.ZERO

	print(\"BEM-VINDO AO LOOP \", player.loop_count)
	print(\"Dano: x\", player.damage_multiplier)
	print(\"XP: x\", player.xp_multiplier)
	print(\"Vida dos inimigos: x\", get_enemy_multiplier())

func get_enemy_multiplier() -> float:
	return pow(2.0, player.loop_count)

# =============================================================================
# 9. GERAÇÃO DE INIMIGOS
# =============================================================================

func spawn_enemy(type: int = -1) -> void:
	if enemies.size() >= MAX_ENEMIES:
		return

	if type == -1:
		type = (
			EnemyType.MOUSERTRAP
			if rng.randf() < 0.65
			else EnemyType.MAFIA_CAT
		)

	var enemy = EnemyClass.new(type, get_enemy_multiplier())

	var angle = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
	var distance = rng.randf_range(500.0, 700.0)

	enemy.position = player.position + Vector2(
		cos(angle) * distance,
		sin(angle) * distance
	)

	enemies.append(enemy)

# =============================================================================
# 10. SISTEMA DE COMBATE
# =============================================================================

func find_nearest_enemy() -> EnemyClass:
	var nearest = null
	var nearest_distance = INF

	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance < nearest_distance:
			nearest_distance = distance
			nearest = enemy

	return nearest

func perform_attack() -> void:
	var weapon = player.active_weapon

	if not weapon.can_shoot():
		return

	var target = find_nearest_enemy()

	if target == null:
		return

	var distance = player.position.distance_to(target.position)

	if distance > weapon.range_dist:
		return

	if not weapon.shoot():
		return

	var final_damage = weapon.damage * player.get_damage_multiplier()

	var double_shot = player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) > 0
	var flaming = player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) > 0
	var fusion = player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) > 0

	match weapon.type:

		0: # DESERT EAGLE
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

		1: # SHOTGUN
			var direction = (target.position - player.position).normalized()

			for enemy in enemies:
				if enemy.is_dead:
					continue

				var enemy_distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

				if enemy_distance > weapon.range_dist:
					continue

				var enemy_direction = (
					enemy.position - player.position
				).normalized()

				var angle = abs(direction.angle_to(enemy_direction))

				if angle <= deg_to_rad(35):
					var distance_multiplier = clamp(
						1.0 - enemy_distance / (weapon.range_dist * 1.5),
						0.25,
						1.0
					)

					apply_damage_to_enemy(
						enemy,
						final_damage * distance_multiplier
					)

		2: # THOMPSON
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

	if flaming or fusion:
		apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage * 0.20)

func apply_damage_to_enemy(enemy, damage: float) -> void:
	if enemy == null or enemy.is_dead:
		return

	if enemy.take_damage(damage):
		on_enemy_killed(enemy)

func on_enemy_killed(enemy) -> void:
	total_kills += 1
	player.score += 10

	print(\"Inimigo eliminado!\")

	add_xp(enemy.xp_reward)

	if enemy.is_boss:
		reward_boss()
		return

	drop_loot(enemy)

func drop_loot(enemy) -> void:
	match enemy.enemy_type:

		0:
			if rng.randf() < SUPER_CHEESE_DROP_CHANCE:
				player.activate_super_cheese()
			else:
				add_xp(10)

		1:
			player.money += 2
			add_xp(20)

# =============================================================================
# 11. RECEBIMENTO DE DANO
# =============================================================================

func damage_player(amount: int) -> void:
	var reduction = player.skills.get(\"reinforced_vest\", 0)
	var final_damage = max(1, amount - reduction)

	player.take_damage(final_damage)

	if player.current_hearts <= 0:
		end_game()

# =============================================================================
# 12. MOVIMENTAÇÃO
# =============================================================================

func move_player(delta: float) -> void:
	var direction = Input.get_vector(
		\"ui_left\",
		\"ui_right\",
		\"ui_up\",
		\"ui_down\"
	)

	player.velocity = direction * (
		player.base_speed * player.speed_multiplier
	)

	player.position += player.velocity * delta

	player.position.x = clamp(
		player.position.x,
		-arena_size.x / 2,
		arena_size.x / 2
	)

	player.position.y = clamp(
		player.position.y,
		-arena_size.y / 2,
		arena_size.y / 2
	)

# =============================================================================
# 13. ATUALIZAÇÃO DOS INIMIGOS
# =============================================================================

func update_enemies(delta: float) -> void:
	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance > enemy.attack_range:
			enemy.move_towards(player.position, delta)
		else:
			if enemy.update_attack(delta):
				damage_player(enemy.damage)

	enemies = enemies.filter(
		func(enemy):
			return not enemy.is_dead
	)

# =============================================================================
# 14. INICIALIZAÇÃO E CICLO PRINCIPAL
# =============================================================================

func _ready() -> void:
	rng.randomize()

	if auto_start:
		start_game()

func start_game() -> void:
	player = PlayerClass.new(starting_weapon)

	enemies.clear()
	projectiles.clear()

	current_level = 1
	current_xp = 0
	xp_to_level_up = 100

	total_kills = 0
	total_cheese = 0
	elapsed_time = 0.0
	spawn_timer = 0.0

	game_over = false
	game_running = true

	player.position = Vector2.ZERO

	print(\"================================\")
	print(\"O RATO DETETIVE\")
	print(\"JOGO INICIADO!\")
	print(\"Arma inicial: \", WeaponType.keys()[starting_weapon])
	print(\"================================\")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not game_running or game_over:
		return

	elapsed_time += delta

	player.update_timers(delta)
	player.active_weapon.update(delta)

	move_player(delta)

	if auto_spawn:
		spawn_timer += delta

		if spawn_timer >= SPAWN_INTERVAL:
			spawn_timer = 0.0
			spawn_enemy()

	update_enemies(delta)
	perform_attack()

func end_game() -> void:
	if game_over:
		return

	game_over = true
	game_running = false

	print(\"\n========== FIM DE JOGO ==========\")
	print(\"Loops alcançados: \", player.loop_count)
	print(\"Nível: \", current_level)
	print(\"Inimigos eliminados: \", total_kills)
	print(\"Queijo coletado: \", total_cheese)
	print(\"Pontuação: \", player.score)
	print(\"Tempo sobrevivido: \", elapsed_time)

func restart_game() -> void:
	start_game()

# =============================================================================
# 15. CONTROLES DE TESTE
# =============================================================================

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not game_running:
		if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_accept\") and game_over:
			restart_game()
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_cancel\"):
		player.active_weapon.reload()

	if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_accept\"):
		if pending_skills.size() > 0:
			select_skill(0)

	var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
	var base_speed := 220.0

	var max_hearts := 5
	var current_hearts := 5
	var hits_per_heart := 2
	var current_heart_hits := 2

	var is_invulnerable := false
	var invulnerable_timer := 0.0

	var loop_count := 0
	var damage_multiplier := 1.0
	var xp_multiplier := 1.0
	var speed_multiplier := 1.0

	var super_cheese_timer := 0.0
	var is_super_cheese_active := false

	var active_weapon
	var skills: Dictionary = {}

	var money := 0
	var score := 0

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		active_weapon = WeaponClass.new(weapon_type)

	func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
		if is_invulnerable or current_hearts <= 0:
			return

		current_heart_hits -= amount

		if current_heart_hits <= 0:
			current_hearts -= 1
			current_heart_hits = hits_per_heart

			print(\"Coração perdido! Restantes: \", current_hearts)

			if current_hearts <= 0:
				die()
			else:
				trigger_invulnerability(1.0)

	func trigger_invulnerability(duration: float) -> void:
		is_invulnerable = true
		invulnerable_timer = max(invulnerable_timer, duration)

	func update_timers(delta: float) -> void:
		if is_invulnerable:
			invulnerable_timer -= delta

			if invulnerable_timer <= 0:
				is_invulnerable = false
				invulnerable_timer = 0

		if is_super_cheese_active:
			super_cheese_timer -= delta

			if super_cheese_timer <= 0:
				is_super_cheese_active = false
				super_cheese_timer = 0
				print(\"Superqueijo terminou!\")

	func activate_super_cheese() -> void:
		is_super_cheese_active = true
		super_cheese_timer = 30.0
		trigger_invulnerability(30.0)

		print(\"SUPERCHEESE! Dano x10 e invulnerabilidade por 30 segundos!\")

	func get_damage_multiplier() -> float:
		var multiplier := damage_multiplier

		if is_super_cheese_active:
			multiplier *= 10.0

		if skills.has(\"damage\"):
			multiplier *= skills[\"damage\"]

		return multiplier

	func die() -> void:
		current_hearts = 0
		print(\"FIM DE JOGO: O detetive caiu na sarjeta.\")

class WeaponClass:
	var type: int

	var damage := 0.0
	var fire_rate := 0.0
	var max_ammo := 0
	var current_ammo := 0
	var reload_time := 0.0
	var range_dist := 0.0

	var fire_timer := 0.0
	var reload_timer := 0.0
	var is_reloading := false

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		type = weapon_type

		match type:
			0: # DESERT EAGLE
				damage = 35.0
				fire_rate = 0.6
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 1.2
				range_dist = 800.0

			1: # SHOTGUN
				damage = 50.0
				fire_rate = 1.2
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 2.5
				range_dist = 350.0

			2: # THOMPSON
				damage = 8.0
				fire_rate = 0.15
				max_ammo = 49
				reload_time = 2.0
				range_dist = 500.0

		current_ammo = max_ammo

	func update(delta: float) -> void:
		fire_timer = max(0.0, fire_timer - delta)

		if is_reloading:
			reload_timer -= delta

			if reload_timer <= 0:
				current_ammo = max_ammo
				is_reloading = false
				print(\"Arma recarregada!\")

	func can_shoot() -> bool:
		return not is_reloading and current_ammo > 0 and fire_timer <= 0

	func shoot() -> bool:
		if not can_shoot():
			return false

		current_ammo -= 1
		fire_timer = fire_rate

		if current_ammo <= 0:
			reload()

		return true

	func reload() -> void:
		if is_reloading or current_ammo == max_ammo:
			return

		is_reloading = true
		reload_timer = reload_time

		print(\"Recarregando...\")

class EnemyClass:
	var enemy_type: int

	var position := Vector2.ZERO
	var health := 0.0
	var max_health := 0.0
	var speed := 0.0
	var damage := 0

	var attack_range := 35.0
	var attack_cooldown := 1.0
	var attack_timer := 0.0

	var xp_reward := 0
	var is_dead := false
	var is_boss := false

	func _init(type: int, loop_multiplier: float):
		enemy_type = type

		match type:
			0: # RAT0EIRA
				max_health = 20.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 180.0
				damage = 1
				xp_reward = 15

			1: # GATO MAFIOSO
				max_health = 60.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 120.0
				damage = 2
				xp_reward = 40

			2: # CHEFÃO
				max_health = 1000.0 * loop_multiplier
				speed = 75.0
				damage = 2
				xp_reward = 500
				attack_range = 65.0
				attack_cooldown = 1.5
				is_boss = true

		health = max_health

	func take_damage(amount: float) -> bool:
		if is_dead:
			return false

		health -= amount

		if health <= 0:
			health = 0
			is_dead = true
			return true

		return false

	func move_towards(target: Vector2, delta: float) -> void:
		var direction := target - position

		if direction.length() > 0:
			position += direction.normalized() * speed * delta

	func update_attack(delta: float) -> bool:
		attack_timer = max(0.0, attack_timer - delta)

		if attack_timer <= 0:
			attack_timer = attack_cooldown
			return true

		return false

	for skill_id in skill_database:

		var current_level = player.skills.get(skill_id, 0)

		if current_level < skill[\"max_level\"]:
			if skill_id == \"flaming_fusion\":
				continue

			available.append(skill_id)

	var choices: Array = []

	while choices.size() < amount and available.size() > 0:
		var index = rng.randi_range(0, available.size() - 1)
		choices.append(available[index])
		available.remove_at(index)

	return choices

	for i in range(pending_skills.size()):
		var skill_id = pending_skills[i]

			\" | Raridade: \",

			\" | \",
			skill[\"description\"]
		)

	if pending_skills.is_empty():
		print(\"Nenhuma habilidade disponível.\")

func select_skill(index: int) -> void:

		print(\"Escolha inválida.\")
		return

	var skill_id = pending_skills[index]
	var current_level = player.skills.get(skill_id, 0)

	player.skills[skill_id] = current_level + 1

	match skill_id:
		\"speed\":
			player.speed_multiplier *= 1.10

		\"damage\":
			pass # Aplicado pelo multiplicador de dano.

		\"reinforced_vest\":
			pass # Aplicado no cálculo de dano recebido.

		\"rapid_fire\":
			player.active_weapon.fire_rate *= 0.80

		\"flaming_cigar\":
			pass # Efeito incendiário aplicado no combate.

		\"double_shot\":
			pass # Aplicado no disparo.

		\"detective_eye\":
			player.active_weapon.range_dist *= 1.40

	_check_fusion()

	print(\"Habilidade adquirida: \", skill_database[skill_id][\"name\"])

	pending_skills.clear()

func _check_fusion() -> void:
	if (
		player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) >= 1
		and player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) >= 1
		and player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) == 0
	):
		player.skills[\"flaming_fusion\"] = 1
		player.skills[\"flaming_cigar\"] = 0
		player.skills[\"double_shot\"] = 0

		print(\"FUSÃO DESBLOQUEADA: CHAMA DO SUBMUNDO!\")

	current_xp += gained
	total_cheese += gained

	print(\"Queijo obtido: \", gained)

	while current_xp >= xp_to_level_up and game_running:
		current_xp -= xp_to_level_up

func level_up() -> void:

	xp_to_level_up = int(ceil(xp_to_level_up * 1.3))

	print(\"\n========== LEVEL UP ==========\")
	print(\"Nível atual: \", current_level)

	if current_level % 10 == 0:
		trigger_miniboss_encounter()
	else:

func trigger_miniboss_encounter() -> void:

	var boss = EnemyClass.new(
		EnemyType.MAFIA_BOSS,
		get_enemy_multiplier()

	boss.position = player.position + Vector2(300, 0)
	enemies.append(boss)

	print(\"Derrote o chefão para receber uma recompensa lendária!\")

func reward_boss() -> void:
	player.money += 100
	player.score += 1000

	print(\"CHEFÃO DERROTADO!\")
	print(\"Recompensa: $100 e habilidade lendária!\")

	var legendary_skills: Array = []

	for skill_id in skill_database:
		if skill_database[skill_id][\"rarity\"] == Rarity.LEGENDARY:
			if player.skills.get(skill_id, 0) == 0:
				legendary_skills.append(skill_id)

	if legendary_skills.size() > 0:
		var chosen = legendary_skills[
			rng.randi_range(0, legendary_skills.size() - 1)
		]
		player.skills[chosen] = 1
		print(\"Habilidade lendária adquirida: \", skill_database[chosen][\"name\"])

func trigger_ground_hole_loop() -> void:
	print(\"\nPORTAL DO BUEIRO ABERTO!\")

	player.loop_count += 1

	player.damage_multiplier *= 2.0
	player.xp_multiplier *= 2.0

	current_level = 1
	current_xp = 0
	xp_to_level_up = 100

	player.position = Vector2.ZERO

	print(\"BEM-VINDO AO LOOP \", player.loop_count)
	print(\"Dano: x\", player.damage_multiplier)
	print(\"XP: x\", player.xp_multiplier)
	print(\"Vida dos inimigos: x\", get_enemy_multiplier())

func get_enemy_multiplier() -> float:
	return pow(2.0, player.loop_count)

func spawn_enemy(type: int = -1) -> void:
	if enemies.size() >= MAX_ENEMIES:
		return

	if type == -1:
		type = (
			EnemyType.MOUSERTRAP
			if rng.randf() < 0.65
			else EnemyType.MAFIA_CAT
		)

	var enemy = EnemyClass.new(type, get_enemy_multiplier())

	var angle = rng.randf_range(0.0, TAU)
	var distance = rng.randf_range(500.0, 700.0)

	enemy.position = player.position + Vector2(
		cos(angle) * distance,
		sin(angle) * distance
	)

	enemies.append(enemy)

func find_nearest_enemy() -> EnemyClass:
	var nearest = null
	var nearest_distance = INF

	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance < nearest_distance:
			nearest_distance = distance
			nearest = enemy

	return nearest

func perform_attack() -> void:
	var weapon = player.active_weapon

	if not weapon.can_shoot():
		return

	var target = find_nearest_enemy()

	if target == null:
		return

	var distance = player.position.distance_to(target.position)

	if distance > weapon.range_dist:
		return

	if not weapon.shoot():
		return

	var final_damage = weapon.damage * player.get_damage_multiplier()

	var double_shot = player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) > 0
	var flaming = player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) > 0
	var fusion = player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) > 0

	match weapon.type:

		0: # DESERT EAGLE
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

		1: # SHOTGUN
			var direction = (target.position - player.position).normalized()

			for enemy in enemies:
				if enemy.is_dead:
					continue

				var enemy_distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

				if enemy_distance > weapon.range_dist:
					continue

				var enemy_direction = (
					enemy.position - player.position
				).normalized()

				var angle = abs(direction.angle_to(enemy_direction))

				if angle <= deg_to_rad(35):
					var distance_multiplier = clamp(
						1.0 - enemy_distance / (weapon.range_dist * 1.5),
						0.25,
						1.0
					)

					apply_damage_to_enemy(
						enemy,
						final_damage * distance_multiplier
					)

		2: # THOMPSON
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

	if flaming or fusion:
		apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage * 0.20)

func apply_damage_to_enemy(enemy, damage: float) -> void:
	if enemy == null or enemy.is_dead:
		return

	if enemy.take_damage(damage):
		on_enemy_killed(enemy)

func on_enemy_killed(enemy) -> void:
	total_kills += 1
	player.score += 10

	print(\"Inimigo eliminado!\")

	add_xp(enemy.xp_reward)

	if enemy.is_boss:
		reward_boss()
		return

	drop_loot(enemy)

func drop_loot(enemy) -> void:
	match enemy.enemy_type:

		0:
			if rng.randf() < SUPER_CHEESE_DROP_CHANCE:
				player.activate_super_cheese()
			else:
				add_xp(10)

		1:
			player.money += 2
			add_xp(20)

# =============================================================================
# 11. RECEBIMENTO DE DANO
# =============================================================================

func damage_player(amount: int) -> void:
	var reduction = player.skills.get(\"reinforced_vest\", 0)
	var final_damage = max(1, amount - reduction)

	player.take_damage(final_damage)

	if player.current_hearts <= 0:
		end_game()

# =============================================================================
# 12. MOVIMENTAÇÃO
# =============================================================================

func move_player(delta: float) -> void:
	var direction = Input.get_vector(
		\"ui_left\",
		\"ui_right\",
		\"ui_up\",
		\"ui_down\"
	)

	player.velocity = direction * (
		player.base_speed * player.speed_multiplier
	)

	player.position += player.velocity * delta

	player.position.x = clamp(
		player.position.x,
		-arena_size.x / 2,
		arena_size.x / 2
	)

	player.position.y = clamp(
		player.position.y,
		-arena_size.y / 2,
		arena_size.y / 2
	)

# =============================================================================
# 13. ATUALIZAÇÃO DOS INIMIGOS
# =============================================================================

func update_enemies(delta: float) -> void:
	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance > enemy.attack_range:
			enemy.move_towards(player.position, delta)
		else:
			if enemy.update_attack(delta):
				damage_player(enemy.damage)

	enemies = enemies.filter(
		func(enemy):
			return not enemy.is_dead
	)

# =============================================================================
# 14. INICIALIZAÇÃO E CICLO PRINCIPAL
# =============================================================================

func _ready() -> void:
	rng.randomize()

	if auto_start:
		start_game()

func start_game() -> void:
	player = PlayerClass.new(starting_weapon)

	enemies.clear()
	projectiles.clear()

	current_level = 1
	current_xp = 0
	xp_to_level_up = 100

	total_kills = 0
	total_cheese = 0
	elapsed_time = 0.0
	spawn_timer = 0.0

	game_over = false
	game_running = true

	player.position = Vector2.ZERO

	print(\"================================\")
	print(\"O RATO DETETIVE\")
	print(\"JOGO INICIADO!\")
	print(\"Arma inicial: \", WeaponType.keys()[starting_weapon])
	print(\"================================\")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not game_running or game_over:
		return

	elapsed_time += delta

	player.update_timers(delta)
	player.active_weapon.update(delta)

	move_player(delta)

	if auto_spawn:
		spawn_timer += delta

		if spawn_timer >= SPAWN_INTERVAL:
			spawn_timer = 0.0
			spawn_enemy()

	update_enemies(delta)
	perform_attack()

func end_game() -> void:
	if game_over:
		return

	game_over = true
	game_running = false

	print(\"\n========== FIM DE JOGO ==========\")
	print(\"Loops alcançados: \", player.loop_count)
	print(\"Nível: \", current_level)
	print(\"Inimigos eliminados: \", total_kills)
	print(\"Queijo coletado: \", total_cheese)
	print(\"Pontuação: \", player.score)
	print(\"Tempo sobrevivido: \", elapsed_time)

func restart_game() -> void:
	start_game()

# =============================================================================
# 15. CONTROLES DE TESTE
# =============================================================================

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not game_running:
		if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_accept\") and game_over:
			restart_game()
		return

	if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_cancel\"):
		player.active_weapon.reload()

	if event.is_action_pressed(\"ui_accept\"):
		if pending_skills.size() > 0:
			select_skill(0)

	var range_dist := 0.0

	var reload_timer := 0.0
	var is_reloading := false

	func _init(weapon_type: int):
		type = weapon_type

		match type:
			0: # DESERT EAGLE
				damage = 35.0
				fire_rate = 0.6
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 1.2
				range_dist = 800.0

			1: # SHOTGUN
				damage = 50.0
				fire_rate = 1.2
				max_ammo = 7
				reload_time = 2.5
				range_dist = 350.0

			2: # THOMPSON
				damage = 8.0
				fire_rate = 0.15
				max_ammo = 49
				reload_time = 2.0
				range_dist = 500.0

		current_ammo = max_ammo

	func update(delta: float) -> void:
		fire_timer = max(0.0, fire_timer - delta)

		if is_reloading:
			reload_timer -= delta

			if reload_timer <= 0:
				current_ammo = max_ammo
				is_reloading = false
				print(\"Arma recarregada!\")

	func can_shoot() -> bool:
		return not is_reloading and current_ammo > 0 and fire_timer <= 0

	func shoot() -> bool:
		if not can_shoot():
			return false

		current_ammo -= 1
		fire_timer = fire_rate

		if current_ammo <= 0:
			reload()

		return true

	func reload() -> void:
		if is_reloading or current_ammo == max_ammo:
			return

		is_reloading = true
		reload_timer = reload_time

		print(\"Recarregando...\")

func find_nearest_enemy() -> EnemyClass:
	var nearest = null
	var nearest_distance = INF

	for enemy in enemies:
		if enemy.is_dead:
			continue

		var distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

		if distance < nearest_distance:
			nearest_distance = distance
			nearest = enemy

	return nearest

func perform_attack() -> void:
	var weapon = player.active_weapon

	if not weapon.can_shoot():
		return

	var target = find_nearest_enemy()

	if target == null:
		return

	var distance = player.position.distance_to(target.position)

	if distance > weapon.range_dist:
		return

	if not weapon.shoot():
		return

	var final_damage = weapon.damage * player.get_damage_multiplier()

	var double_shot = player.skills.get(\"double_shot\", 0) > 0
	var flaming = player.skills.get(\"flaming_cigar\", 0) > 0
	var fusion = player.skills.get(\"flaming_fusion\", 0) > 0

	match weapon.type:

		0: # DESERT EAGLE
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

		1: # SHOTGUN
			var direction = (target.position - player.position).normalized()

			for enemy in enemies:
				if enemy.is_dead:
					continue

				var enemy_distance = player.position.distance_to(enemy.position)

				if enemy_distance > weapon.range_dist:
					continue

				var enemy_direction = (
					enemy.position - player.position
				).normalized()

				var angle = abs(direction.angle_to(enemy_direction))

				if angle <= deg_to_rad(35):
					var distance_multiplier = clamp(
						1.0 - enemy_distance / (weapon.range_dist * 1.5),
						0.25,
						1.0
					)

					apply_damage_to_enemy(
						enemy,
						final_damage * distance_multiplier
					)

		2: # THOMPSON
			apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

			if double_shot or fusion:
				apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage)

	if flaming or fusion:
		apply_damage_to_enemy(target, final_damage * 0.20)

func apply_damage_to_enemy(enemy, damage: float) -> void:
	if enemy == null or enemy.is_dead:
		return

	if enemy.take_damage(damage):
		on_enemy_killed(enemy)

func on_enemy_killed(enemy) -> void:
	total_kills += 1
	player.score += 10

	print(\"Inimigo eliminado!\")

	add_xp(enemy.xp_reward)

	if enemy.is_boss:

	drop_loot(enemy)

func update_enemies(delta: float) -> void:
